commits.author: Claude
commits.message:
refactor: Complete production-grade modernization of currency converter

Major changes:
- Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.3.5 with Java 21
- Replace EHCache with Caffeine caching
- Add OpenAPI/Swagger documentation (springdoc-openapi)
- Implement circuit breaker and retry with Resilience4j
- Add Prometheus metrics and Actuator endpoints
- Restructure codebase with clean architecture patterns
- Use Java Records for immutable DTOs
- Add comprehensive exception handling with GlobalExceptionHandler
- Add comprehensive test suite (unit + integration tests)
- Add Docker support with multi-stage builds
- Add docker-compose with optional monitoring stack
- Update README with comprehensive API documentation
- Add legacy endpoint support for backward compatibility

Technical improvements:
- Type-safe Currency enum with ISO 4217 codes
- Bean Validation for request parameters
- Structured error responses
- Health checks and observability
- JaCoCo code coverage
- WireMock for integration testing
